spans.label: plonky2, channel-tree leaf/proof and constants imports
spans.note: Semantics comes from an imported crate/gadget/hash; modelled as an opaque callback or premise. Merkle openings and leaf hashing come from imported trees and stay opaque.

spans.label: AccountStateError enum
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. thiserror Display formatting is not modelled.

spans.label: AccountState struct fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Field order transcribed; leaf internals belong to channel_tree.rs.

spans.label: AccountState::new
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. `new` assembles, verifies and returns the arguments unchanged.

spans.label: AccountState::verify (send-leaf then channel-leaf inclusion)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. The two Merkle verifications are opaque callbacks; only their arguments, order and error precedence are modelled.

spans.label: AccountStateTarget struct fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. The target struct is represented by the gate predicate over the same fields.

spans.label: AccountStateTarget::new (allocation, range checks, two openings)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Range checks are a declarative table, not emitted gates; the openings are the same opaque callbacks.

spans.label: AccountStateTarget::set_witness
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Only the order in which fields are written is modelled.

spans.label: closing brace
spans.note: No executable constraint is inferred from comments or blank lines.

boundaries.name: merkle-opening
boundaries.obligation: IncrementalMerkleProof::verify, SparseMerkleProof::verify and their target counterparts are opaque decision callbacks; no soundness of the openings is established.

boundaries.name: leaf-hashing
boundaries.obligation: SendLeaf/ChannelLeaf Poseidon leaf hashing (including the CHANNEL_LEAF_DOMAIN tag) is not modelled; leaves are compared as structures.

boundaries.name: merkle-index-truncation
boundaries.obligation: MerkleEnv.truncates is transcribed from BitPath::pop rather than proved about the Rust code.

boundaries.name: plonky2-gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: No proof that AccountStateGates corresponds to the constraints AccountStateTarget::new emits.

boundaries.name: channel-id-nonzero
boundaries.obligation: ChannelId::new rejects the reserved id 0 natively; nothing in the circuit does, and the model only exhibits that gap rather than resolving it.
